name: io.github.chrischall/tripadvisor-mcp
description: TripAdvisor location search, details, photos, and reviews via the Terra API

environmentVariables.name: TRIPADVISOR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your TripAdvisor Terra API key (tripadvisor.com/developers). Needed by the Terra tools; the ta_web_* tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: TRIPADVISOR_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to cache search responses (default: 300; `0` disables).

environmentVariables.name: TRIPADVISOR_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout for the optional browser bridge (default: 30000).

environmentVariables.name: TRIPADVISOR_DEBUG_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Set to `1` to log browser-bridge requests to stderr.

environmentVariables.name: TRIPADVISOR_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Bridge port override (default: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT, else 37149). Tests only.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Localhost concentrator port (default 37149). On one machine every MCP shares the concentrator, so move it for ALL of them or not at all.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only, anything else is ignored). Keep on loopback — it exists for ONE topology: a hosted child in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where to store the long-term identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/; an absolute path only, anything else is ignored). Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they can share one identity.
